# Project One Salon Suites

> Private, lockable salon suites for licensed beauty professionals at 4127 Manchester Ave, St. Louis, MO 63110 (The Grove). Weekly rent, no commission.

## Key facts

- Window suite: 140 sq ft, storefront windows, $325 per week
- Interior suite: 120 sq ft, daylight LED panels, $285 per week
- Studio suite: 180 sq ft, corner windows, $375 per week
- Lease: 6 or 12 months, deposit of one week of rent, rent by weekly auto-pay
- Tenant perk: half rent your first month, plus one rent-free week every year
- Included: utilities, Wi-Fi, laundry, weekly cleaning of common areas, 24/7 keyless entry, a smart lock with your own code
- Availability: 1 suite open
- Tours: by appointment, Tuesday to Saturday, 10am to 6pm. Phone (314) 555-0142, email hello@projectonesalonsuites.com
